collectionSource.note: Includes the reusable part library. Existing curated entries are preserved; added entries have not been drafted or tested.

photoMatching.purpose: Compare an uploaded reference photo with supported designs, using each design description and visualMatching cues.
instructions: Match garment or object category first, then silhouette, neckline, sleeves, waist, length, closures, seams and pockets.
Treat option-dependent features as variations, not features guaranteed in every version.
Return up to three supported designIds with visible evidence, uncertainty and differences; do not force a match.
A visually similar design is a starting point, not an exact reconstruction of the photographed garment.
Do not infer body measurements, hidden construction or fabric stretch from the photo.
Foundation blocks are development starting points; prefer finished designs when their silhouette matches. Exclude the part library from finished-garment matches.
